messages:
Ravi Kumar: Hey team — noticed some new hires reporting two orientation events in their calendars: one says 'New Hire Orientation (Hosted)' with a Zoom link, the other says 'New Hire Orientation - East Coast' with a Teams link. Anyone know why both got created?
Priya Singh: That was my bad, I duplicated the Google Calendar event when trying to create a timezone-friendly repeat. Didn't realize Teams auto-created a meeting when I pasted the cross-org template. Sorry!
Alex Gomez: No worries. Quick question: which link should folks use if they're on a company laptop vs personal device? Our device SSO blocks Teams for contractor laptops.
onboarding-bot: onboarding-bot archived event 'New Hire Orientation - East Coast (Teams)' and scheduled consolidated session 'New Hire Orientation - Consolidated' 2026-05-10T14:00:00Z. Zoom link: https://zoom.redwood.com/j/1230984567 (passcode: 9931)
Priya Singh: Consolidated session is the canonical one. I'll update the description and remove the Teams-only repeat. Also adding an .ics and a plain-text link in the description for people who import into other calendars.
Nadia Park: Can you add a short note on recordings? Our compliance folks need to know retention and access: internal staff vs external contractors.
Ravi Kumar: Good point. Priya, can we set recording visibility to 'redwood.com domain only' and upload a copy to the onboarding drive. Legal asked for 180 days retention for internal hires and 30 days for contractors.
Priya Singh: Done. Updated event description: "Recording: uploaded to Drive (internal hires: 180 days; contractors: 30 days). If you need a copy after expiry contact legal-onboarding@redwood.com."
Alex Gomez: Timezone nit: some folks in NZ see the consolidated time as 03:00 local. Can we add an explicit UTC time in the description and examples for common zones?
Priya Singh: Added line: "Start time: 14:00 UTC (06:00 PT / 09:00 ET / 14:00 BST / 03:00 NZST)" and a note: "If your calendar still shows the old Teams event, delete it and accept the consolidated invite or DM Priya to be re-invited."
Ravi Kumar: Thanks. Recap for new hires: use the Consolidated Zoom link, recording will be uploaded to onboarding drive, retention differs by hire type, .ics attached, UTC times included. Welcome aboard everyone! :tada:
